transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because… I’ve been getting scared by some thoughts in the mornings. Sometimes I think it might be easier if I just didn’t wake up. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself, but it frightened me enough to come in.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, especially in the mornings?

Yes… I suppose so. I still go to things, like book club or the dance night, but I don’t really feel part of it. It’s like I’m watching from behind glass.

Even my garden, or cooking for the neighbors… it just doesn’t give me that little lift it used to.
Do these feelings of being down or disconnected tend to be worse in the morning and improve as the day goes on?
I’m not sure, really. Mornings can feel… heavier sometimes, but I haven’t paid close attention to whether it reliably lifts later. It varies, I suppose.
Have you noticed that your mood tends to stay low throughout most of the day, nearly every day?
I don’t really know. I haven’t been tracking it that closely… it’s just been hard, on and off.
Do you find that your low mood tends to last for most of the day, and happens on most days, even if it varies a little?
I’m not sure I can say “most of the day” or “most days.” It’s… around a lot, but I haven’t really measured it like that. Some days are just flatter than others.
Can you tell me if your low mood tends to happen on most days and, when it does, does it last for most of the day?
I don’t really know how to pin it down that way. It’s there often enough that I notice it, but I can’t honestly say whether it’s most days or most of the day.
Can you say that your low mood happens on most days, even if it doesn't last all day?
I still don’t know if I’d say most days. It feels like it comes up a fair amount, but I haven’t really kept track.
Can you recall if you've had a low mood on more days than not over the past two weeks?
I can’t really recall clearly. I know I’ve felt low at times over the past couple weeks, but whether it was more days than not… I’m not sure.
Over the past two weeks, would you say that you have had a low mood on most days, even if it wasn’t all day every day?
I’m sorry, I still don’t really know. Some days, yes, I feel low, but I can’t say for sure it’s been most days.
Over the past two weeks, would you say that you felt low or down on more days than not, even if it wasn’t all day every day?
I’m not really sure. I’ve had some down times, yes, but I can’t honestly say whether it was more days than not.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that you felt down or low on most days, even if it wasn’t all day every day?
I don’t know… I’ve tried to think about it, but it’s kind of blurred together. Some days I do feel down, but I can’t really say if it was most days.
Looking back over the past two weeks, would you say that most days had at least some time when you felt down or low, even if it wasn’t all day?
I’m still not sure. There were times I felt low, yes, but I can’t really sort out whether that was most days or not.
Can you say that, over the past two weeks, you felt low or down on the majority of days, even if it wasn’t present all day each day?
I don’t think I can say that for sure. It’s been… mixed, and I haven’t really kept track day by day.
Can you say that, over the past two weeks, you felt low or down on at least half of the days, even if it wasn’t present all day each day?
I’m sorry, I still can’t really say. Half the days… maybe, but I’m not sure enough to answer yes.
Can you say that, over the past two weeks, you felt low or down on at least half of the days, even if it wasn’t present all day each day?
I know you’re asking clearly, but… I still don’t feel certain. I had low times, yes, but saying it was at least half the days—I’m not sure I can say that.
Can you say that, over the past two weeks, you felt low or down on at least half of the days, even if it wasn’t present all day each day?
I can’t really pin it down like that. I’ve had some low spells, but I’m not sure I could honestly say it was half the days.
Over the past two weeks, would you say that you felt depressed or down on at least half of the days, even if it wasn’t present all day each day?
I’m not sure I can say that. I know I’ve felt down at times, but whether it was half the days… I just don’t know.
Over the past two weeks, would you say that you felt low or down on at least half of the days, even if it wasn’t present all day each day?
I’m sorry, I really don’t know. Some days were low, but counting whether it was half of them… I can’t say for sure.
Over the past two weeks, would you say that you felt low or down on at least half of the days, even if it wasn’t present all day each day?
I don’t think I can give you a clear yes or no. It’s been up and down, and I haven’t really kept track that closely.
Over the past two weeks, would you say that you felt low or down on at least half of the days, even if it wasn’t present all day each day?
I… I’m still not really sure. It’s hard for me to count it that way. Some days I felt low, but I don’t know if it adds up to half the days.
